name: Survival mode game launches with arithmetic question and exits cleanly
description: User opens Treino Mental, starts Modo Sobrevivencia, verifies the active game interface with arithmetic question and keypad, then safely exits back to the lobby.

planSteps.description: Click on the Treino Mental tab in the top navigation bar
Click on the Modo Sobrevivência card to start the game
Verify the active game screen displays the question header Conta #1 and the numeric keypad
Click the sair button in the top left corner
Verify the user returns to the game lobby displaying the Modo Sobrevivência hero card
